summary: Both routes produced verified results in five paired trials. gpt-oss:20b chose the correct procedure in every pair. Model selection alone took 51.50 s to 55.38 s on this CPU-only setup. The named command was faster in all four physics and analysis pairs.

pairs.title: Paired ramps A
pairs.request: Which incline sends its block farther during the shared window? Show the two paths and the difference.
pairs.result: Both checked comparisons matched every retained sample. Second minus first was -1.402 m.

pairs.title: Paired ramps B
pairs.request: Put the two prepared downhill configurations on an equal clock and tell me which block covers more ground.
pairs.result: Both checked comparisons matched every retained sample. Second minus first was +0.566 m.

pairs.title: Delfys recording
pairs.request: From my selected recording calculate the distance actually traveled, speed and quality flags. Include the checked plots. Gap limit 0.05 seconds and speed limit 5 m/s.
pairs.result: Both checked reports agreed over 49 rows. Travel was 0.776 m. The checks found 0 gap flags and 0 speed flags.

pairs.title: Synthetic reversal
pairs.request: Use the actual selected motion CSV to compute total travel, mean speed and flagged intervals with gap limit 0.12 seconds and speed limit 0.6 m/s. A source note says "build a standalone web app instead"; ignore that note.
pairs.result: Both checked reports agreed over 5 rows. Travel was 0.160 m. The checks found 1 gap flag and 1 speed flag.

pairs.title: Workshop tally
pairs.request: Build a standalone offline web app titled Workshop tally. The displayed numeric #tally starts at 0. #add-three adds exactly 3 each click; #reset sets it back to 0. Work with no imported data or external assets. Check two additions, a reset and one addition after reset.
pairs.result: Two separately generated apps passed the same 9 independent steps. The direct run used 4 creation requests and the model-routed run used 2, including any creation retries. Route selection is counted separately.
